hypotheses.S1_middle_is_sparse_per_example: For layer-8 natural-top queries, median per-example modes needed for 90% absolute contribution mass is at most 64 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S2_adaptive_modes_rescue_middle: For layer-8 natural-top queries, adaptive rank-16 score correlation exceeds fixed spectral rank-16 by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S3_middle_multiplexes_mode_identity: For layer-8 natural-top queries, the median effective number of modes occupying adaptive top-16 slots is at least 128 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S4_middle_is_denser_than_late: Layer-8 natural-top per-example K90 is at least twice layer 17 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S5_middle_has_more_cancellation: Layer-8 natural-top median signed-to-absolute contribution ratio is at least 0.10 below layer 17 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S6_middle_support_size_transfers: Layer-8 natural-top median K90 differs by at most 16 modes between FineWeb and each OOD corpus.
